TITLE: Relative-Band Pulse
DESCRIPTION: Internal renderer-test archetype. Three pulsing lobes -- bass (warm), mid (green), treb (cyan) -- each driven by the PLANNED MilkDrop-class relative reactive bands chroma_AudioBass/Mid/Treb plus their *_att attack axes (docs/06 Sec.7.15, ADR-024). The bands are multiplicative and centred on the neutral 1.0; a band lift swells its lobe and its _att axis flashes a sharper core. Edge case (FORWARD-COMPAT): this scene declares PLANNED symbols that the render path does not yet bind, so each band/att feeds the neutral baseline (band == 1.0, att == 1.0). At that neutral pose the shader renders a calm, TIME-animated three-lobe field -- flat with respect to audio until the Phase-2 relative-band render binding lands, but never black, static, or NaN. Not shipped in the bundled library; reference/test fixture only.
